# Publication fixture — language preservation

Translation was not requested. The canonical draft is Chinese (中文) and uses the terms “配体 L1”“催化剂状态” and “孤立收率”. The journal-readable projection keeps the same language and terms:

> 在限定的催化剂状态与底物范围内，配体 L1 与更高的孤立收率相关；这一判断仍受测量口径和适用边界限制。

The projection may improve sentence order and remove workflow labels, but it must not silently translate this text or rename the chemical terms. A separate, explicitly confirmed translation task would be required.
